title: Finta 2.0: The Future of AI Workflows Is Here
summary: With Finta 2,0, wake up every day with a dashboard that looks across your Inbox, Calendar, Network Connections, Documents, and more to keep you ready for what’s next.
body_markdown:
## **AI Summaries That Keep You Instantly Updated**


Have you ever opened your CRM and thought, “Wait… where did I leave off?”


Finta 2.0 fixes that with built-in AI summaries.


At the top of your workspace, you’ll now see a real-time AI-generated summary based on your recent email activity. No digging. No scrolling. Just clarity.


### **Why it matters:**


- Instantly catch up on conversations
- Stay aligned with investors and prospects
- Reduce context-switching


It’s like having a smart assistant that keeps you in the loop without lifting a finger.


‍


## **Meet Aurora AI: Your Deal-Making Co-Pilot**


‍


This is where things get really interesting.


[Aurora AI](https://finta.ai/product/aurora) isn’t just a feature; it’s the engine behind Finta 2.0’s AI workflows.


It connects to your email, understands your activity, and helps you take action automatically.


No more toggling between tools to get your jobs done; toggle between all of your favorite models in one place.


Instead of choosing just one model to use from Gemini, Chat GPT, or Claude, you can see how all three work for you at once with Aurora.


### **What Aurora AI can do:**


- Pull insights from your weekly email activity
- Suggest and create deal automations
- Keep your pipeline updated in real-time
- Help you stay proactive without manual tracking


Instead of reacting to your CRM, Aurora helps you stay ahead of it with valuable insights.


## **Automations That Actually Work for You**


Let’s face it: manual follow-ups are where deals go to die.


With Finta 2.0, AI-powered automations handle the repetitive stuff so you can focus on building relationships.


### **Key automation capabilities:**


- Automatically trigger follow-ups
- Move deals across stages
- Create workflows based on activity
- Let Aurora AI run automations for you


This is what modern AI workflows should feel like. Intelligent, proactive, and hands-off when you need them to be.


## **Email & Calendar Integration (Finally, Everything in Sync)**


Switching between tools? That’s a productivity killer.


Finta 2.0 brings your communication into one place with a seamless email and calendar connector.


### **What you get:**


- Sync emails directly into your CRM
- Track conversations without manual logging
- Stay updated on meetings and schedules
- Let AI use this data to improve insights and automations


Everything stays connected, so nothing slips through the cracks.


‍


## **Utilize Networks to Unlock Warm Intros**


The Networks function is now improved to make your existing contacts even easier to navigate and prospect from. Connect directly to your email, LinkedIn, or upload a list of contacts that can now become a browsable and enrich-able list of prospects.


## **Your Second Brain: Smarter Document Intelligence**


Your documents shouldn’t just sit there; they should work for you.


With Finta 2.0, you can now ask Aurora questions about the documents in your Document Library.


### **Use cases:**


- Quickly find key investor details
- Extract insights from pitch decks
- Get answers without manually searching


It’s like turning your document library into a searchable knowledge base, all powered by AI.


‍


## **Why Finta 2.0 Changes the Game**


At its core, Finta 2.0 isn’t just about adding features; it’s about removing friction.


For founders, sales teams, and fundraising teams, that means:


- Less manual work
- Better visibility into deals
- Faster decision-making
- More consistent follow-ups


And most importantly, it helps you close deals.


By combining a flexible fundraising CRM, powerful investor pipeline management, and intelligent AI workflows, Finta 2.0 becomes more than a tool… it becomes a second brain and part of your team.


‍
